lines.zh: 我是个会走路的布娃娃
lines.en: I'm a doll that walks.

lines.zh: 棉线松了，我一边走一边掉
lines.en: My stitching's loose; I shed as I walk.

lines.zh: 两条腿硬邦邦的，走得别扭
lines.en: My legs are stiff; I walk awkwardly.

lines.zh: 头发是毛线，走起来乱晃
lines.en: My hair is yarn and swings as I walk.

lines.zh: 我被人缝出来的，缝得不好
lines.en: I was stitched together, badly.
Cotton wads mark where I've been.

lines.zh: 我歪着头走，脖子不听话
lines.en: I walk with my head tilted; my neck won't obey.

lines.zh: 我的步子像有人在提着
lines.en: My steps feel like someone's lifting me.
The smell of black wool lingers.
One eye is bigger than the other.

lines.zh: 我走路时肚子里的东西在响
lines.en: Something rattles inside me when I walk.
I sit on the ground with my feet out.
A loose thread in my hand.

lines.zh: 我在看自己缝歪的胳膊
lines.en: I'm looking at my crooked arm.

lines.zh: 有一根针还插在我肩上
lines.en: A needle is still stuck in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼睛，因为没有眼皮
lines.en: I don't blink; I have no lids.
The cotton in my belly is settling.
I lean and wait for someone to right me.

lines.zh: 嘴是缝出来的，笑不笑都一样
lines.en: My mouth is stitched; smiling makes no difference.
I've sat here a long while.
The wind passes through my seams.
My cotton is on this ground.
I'm listening for whoever moves my threads.
I'm light; a breeze is enough.

lines.zh: 谁把黑色羊毛塞进我肚子里
lines.en: Who stuffed black wool into my belly?
The needle by my hand is gone.

lines.zh: 坐着坐着，我忘了要站起来
lines.en: Sitting here, I forgot to stand.
Do you have thread on your hands?
Have you ever sewn anything?
Don't pull the threads on me.
This face was pieced together.

lines.zh: 你在看哪里，我的眼睛吗
lines.en: Where are you looking? My eyes?

lines.zh: 你看我像看一个坏掉的娃娃
lines.en: You look at me like a broken doll.

lines.zh: 我的头可以转得更多一点
lines.en: My head can turn a little further.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我身上，很重
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me, heavy.
Are you going to pick me up?
Something's moving in my belly.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我只是不会跑
lines.en: I'm not afraid of you; I just can't run.
If the thread snaps, I come apart.
Give me back my needle.
You're counting my loose threads.
Cotton leaks out of me.
One thread snapped.
I fall and get up again.
It isn't pain, only coming apart.
My head lolled onto my shoulder.
That loosened a foot.
My stitching creaks.
You'll have to sew me back.
Don't pull that thread.
Black wool, I know it.

lines.zh: 你给我这个，我就跟你走
lines.en: Give me this and I'll follow you.
Slime balls? Sticky, I like them.
Don't fob me off with something else.
I want to stitch one more piece on.

lines.zh: 这个颜色和我肚子里的像
lines.en: This color matches what's in my belly.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我自己拿
lines.en: Put it down; I'll take it myself.
I'm running short of thread.
Can you give me a needle?

lines.zh: 你拿着它，就像在提着我
lines.en: Holding that, you're almost holding me.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，棉絮掉了一地
lines.en: I hit it and cotton falls everywhere.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我的头歪得更厉害
lines.en: You touched me and my head tilted worse.
I'm soft; collisions make no sound.
That took my arm off.
I fell to one side and can't get up.
You snapped the thread underfoot.
You can push me far.
Touch me and the needle pricks.
I slump against you.
Don't step on my cotton.
I was sewn together.
Dolls have no such thing.

lines.zh: 架子上还有一个，也很旧
lines.en: There's another on the shelf, also old.
Our threads got tangled together.
We're both stuffed with wool.
I don't quite understand that.
I can't stitch a second me.
Don't touch those needles.
Quiet, I hear the threads.
Neither of us grows.
I picked up a needle.
I stuff the cotton back into my belly.
This hand isn't good at picking things up.
I gather the thread off the ground.
When I bend, my head falls off.
This could be stitched on.
I can't lift this; too heavy.
I hide it in my belly.
This thread is mine.
After gathering, I'm messier.
I hear thread over there.
I lean that way.
It's more interesting than I am.
The smell of black wool.
Not far; I'll shift over.
I've fixed on that shadow.
A thread is tangled round my foot.
That one.
I raised a hand.
I drag a loose thread and close in.
Thread wrapped twice around my foot.
It retreats, and I can't follow.
My head tilts that way.
A doll chasing is slow.
Cotton trails behind me.
It's watching me; I watch back.
A little closer and we'll touch.
It's running.
My needle is still in my shoulder.
I stand and watch it go.
The last bit.
I walk crooked, but I keep walking.
I stab down with the needle.
The whole doll slams into it.
My arm swung out.
That split a seam.
I shove with my belly.
The cotton got in its face.
I grab its hand and can't hold.
After hitting, I'm crooked.
Dolls fighting is unseemly.
I stand and wait for the next.

lines.zh: 商人从盒子里把我拿出来
lines.en: The merchant took me out of a box.
I woke when they cut my stitching.
I stand on the ground, knees soft.
I shake and cotton falls.
A needle still sticks in my head.
I turn my head to look around.

lines.zh: 我是用十六个黏液球换来的
lines.en: I cost sixteen slime balls.
Who sewed me this crooked?
I try two steps.
The ground is damp, good.
The moment I opened my eyes, the threads went taut.
I turned half a circle in place.
This body had better hold.
Fire snaps thread and scorches cotton.
I fell and cotton spread out.

lines.zh: 水把我泡软，我塌下去了
lines.en: Water soaked me soft and I collapsed.

lines.zh: 炸得我四个方向都飞了
lines.en: The blast sent me flying in four directions.

lines.zh: 一根东西穿过我，棉飞出来
lines.en: Something went through and cotton burst out.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我的线自己在动
lines.en: The spell hit and my threads moved on their own.
I don't eat; I only wear out.

lines.zh: 雷打来，我身上的针都在响
lines.en: Lightning hit and every needle on me rang.
I fall, and my cotton drifts away.
